name: Adelaide Motorsport Park
reason: The Bend Motorsport Park at Tailem Bend (not Adelaide/Salisbury, which is Wikivoyage's misfiling). SA Tourism's Tailem Bend page lists it as a thing to do; public venue with track experiences, karting and 4WD park, a multi-hour visit. Objection: it is a commercial venue and experiences are paid/event-dependent. Name should be The Bend Motorsport Park (wiki title).

name: Coorong National Park (South East end)
reason: Coorong National Park is a headline draw on the NPWS visitor page (birdwatching, walks, Jacks Point pelican observatory, Parnka Point trail, camping). Keep as one spot named Coorong National Park (drop the '(South East end)' qualifier; the park is a single place, do not list twice with any northern entry). Objection: a long linear park, pin choice at a visitor point such as Parnka Point or Salt Creek, not the centroid.

name: Tilley Swamp
reason: Tilley Swamp Conservation Park: searched parks.sa.gov.au (page 404/absent), SA tourism and Wikivoyage; no visitor-oriented source found. Only birding-society and amateur-radio write-ups, which note no formal tracks inside. No counted source and no defined thing to do.
